sentences.en: I asked him about what he witnessed, but he wasn't very forthcoming.
sentences.zh: 我问他目睹的情况，但他并不太愿意透露。

sentences.en: Fadil was very forthcoming about the details of his relationship with Layla.

sentences.en: Even after several complaints, no response was forthcoming.
sentences.zh: 尽管多次投诉，但仍然没有任何回应。
